name: Instances of the International Planning Competitions, 1998 to 2014
organizers: the IPC organisers, collected by the Potassco group
terms: the instances of the planning competitions, as collected and republished by the Potassco group; no licence file in the collection
note: eight competitions, from 1998 to 2014. This repository keeps the manifest and the pinned commit, never the instances: tools/fetch_upstream.py clones it into a local cache. The CNF encodings are produced on demand by the freeLunch bridge.
